newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian women rush to help Spanish bachelors.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian women rush to help Spanish bachelors.

text.p: Spanish consulates in Brazil have been flooded by calls from women requesting information about a Castilian village whose bachelors were desperately seeking female company, embassy officials said on Tuesday.

Consular officials said phones had been ringing off the hook since Globo Television aired a news story on Sunday about the town of Villamiel where the local bachelor's association was looking for ways to attract young women eager to marry.
"The phone has been ringing non-stop," an official at the Spanish consulate at Sao Paulo said.
Globo said the Villamiel bachelor's association had unsuccesfully tried several strategies in an attempt to attract young women to the town, including a bull-fighting festival last year.
Villamiel Mayor Jose Ramos, himself a bachelor, had gone so far as to make the city's fax available in an effort to help attract young women, the TV station said.
Globo quoted Ramos as saying the next bachelor's association party would be on May 17 -- however he warned visiting women there were no hotels in the town.
